points.description: States that the new (unclassified) data point is added to/compared with the existing labelled (classified/colored) training data, e.g. by computing distances to the labelled points.
Explicitly selects the k nearest data points (the neighbourhood, e.g. a sphere/region containing the k nearest points) around the new point, with k named as the number of neighbours.
Counts the class labels (colors) among the k neighbours and finds the class with the maximum vote (majority voting).
Assigns the new data point to the class with the maximum vote, and presents the steps as pseudo-code in the correct order (add/compare, select k nearest, vote, assign).
points.partial_credit: Correct assignment step stated but steps are not given as ordered pseudo-code, or order is wrong: 0.25

rubric.notes: Full marks need all four steps stated explicitly, in order and as pseudo-code: place new point among labelled data, take the k nearest points, majority vote on class, assign the class. Vague wording (e.g. "looks at neighbours") earns nothing for that point, and a wrong statement in a step cancels it. The terms k nearest points and maximum/majority vote must appear; part marks only where clearly more than half of a point is precise.
